title: Change detection — changed-area interval against the known scene

assertions.derivation: Lab grid contract: 128x128 Byte change mask at 0.001 deg.

KNOWN_ANSWER_MATRIX change family with the documented INCLUSIVE threshold: the scene changes on rows16..31 x cols0..63 (1024 px) plus rows64..95 x cols32..95 (2048 px) = exactly 3072. Catches over- and under-detection and inverted masks.
A change mask is binary; any other stored value is a legend error.
The scene declares 64/16384=0.39% invalid inputs; the correct product masks them. Ratio 0 = forgot to mask; ratio > 0.02 = masked usable data.
A correct mask has exactly two populated states (0 and 1); smeared or ternary legends fail.
